title: Off-by-one Heap Overflow in µD3TN v0.15.1 SPP Parser allows Unauthenticated Remote Attacker to Reliably Cause DoS…
description: An off-by-one heap overflow vulnerability exists in the SPP parser of µD3TN version 0.15.1. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition reliably by triggering the overflow.
